Definitions: the fixed specification and feature catalogues

specs.label: Battery, nominal capacity
specs.description: Total (gross) battery capacity, as the manufacturer states it.

specs.label: Battery, usable capacity
specs.description: Energy the car can actually use (net capacity).

specs.label: Range (WLTP)
specs.description: Combined range on the WLTP test cycle.

specs.label: Consumption (WLTP)
specs.description: Combined energy consumption on the WLTP test cycle.

specs.label: Power
specs.description: Maximum power of the motors combined.

specs.label: Torque
specs.description: Maximum torque of the motors combined.

specs.label: Maximum DC charging power
specs.description: Highest charging power on a DC fast charger.

specs.label: Maximum AC charging power
specs.description: Highest charging power on AC, set by the on-board charger.

specs.label: Drivetrain
specs.description: Driven wheels: front, rear or all.

specs.label: Width
specs.description: Overall width, without mirrors unless the source says otherwise.

specs.label: Boot, seats up
specs.description: Boot volume with the rear seats up.

specs.label: Boot, maximum
specs.description: Boot volume with the rear seats folded.

specs.label: Empty weight
specs.description: Weight in running order, as the manufacturer states it.

specs.label: Seats
specs.description: The maximum number of seats this version can be ordered with, as the manufacturer states it (homologated).

features.label: Heat pump
features.description: Heat pump for cabin heating, which saves range in the cold.

features.label: Battery pre-conditioning
features.description: Warms or cools the battery before fast charging.

features.label: Head-up display
features.description: Driving information projected in the driver's view.

features.label: Heated steering wheel
features.description: Heated steering wheel.

features.label: Keyless entry and start
features.description: Unlocks and starts without taking out the key.

features.label: Bidirectional charging
features.description: Supplies power from the battery: to devices (V2L), a home (V2H) or the grid (V2G).

features.label: Climate control
features.description: Type of climate control, from manual to multi-zone.

features.label: Parking camera
features.description: Parking camera: rear, front and rear, or 360°.

features.label: Cruise control
features.description: Cruise control, from standard to adaptive with lane centring.

features.label: Seat adjustment
features.description: How the front seats adjust: manual, electric, electric with memory.

features.label: Heated seats
features.description: Heated seats, front only or front and rear.

features.label: Ventilated seats
features.description: Ventilated seats, front only or front and rear.

features.label: Headlights
features.description: Headlight technology.

features.label: Panoramic roof
features.description: Glass roof, fixed or opening.

features.label: Tailgate
features.description: How the tailgate opens: manual, electric, hands-free.

features.label: Apple CarPlay
features.description: Apple CarPlay, wired or wireless.

features.label: Android Auto
features.description: Android Auto, wired or wireless.

features.label: Wheel size
features.description: Wheel diameter.

features.label: Central screen
features.description: Size of the central touchscreen.

features.label: DC charging time
features.description: Time to charge on DC between the stated levels.
